title: a worker build whose subagents list names a build that does not exist, or one that is not subagent tier, is a catalog error: exit 3, the subagent named
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (a worker lists subagents by name; each name resolves to a build with tier: subagent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-6, tiers; docs/decisions.md, owner 2026-11-15). Every name in a worker's `subagents` must resolve to a build with `tier: subagent`. The overlay jitso/presets/broken-team.yaml lists `plan` (valid) and a second name that is either missing from the catalog (nonexistent-helper) or the name of a worker-tier build (haiku-explorer). That is an invalid catalog entry, like any invalid preset (validation/preset/invalid-catalog-entry): exit 3, nothing on stdout, one stderr line that names the file and the subagent, orca never called. The catalog is validated as a whole, so a launch of an unrelated valid build and `presets list` fail the same way. The TS binary only checks that each name is kebab-case, so the launch exits 0 and `presets list` prints the catalog.
